hypotheses.persona: Working professional who commutes to an office
hypotheses.rationale: The consistent weekday morning departure pattern with work items (keys, work lanyard, travel mug) and evening returns strongly suggests a regular work commute. This pattern has been observed for nine consecutive weekdays (days 0-4 and days 7-10). The weekend behavior (days 5-6) shows a relaxed routine with no early departure, which is consistent with a professional who doesn't work on weekends.

hypotheses.persona: Student with occasional classes or study groups
hypotheses.rationale: The work lanyard and consistent commuting pattern make this hypothesis increasingly unlikely. Weekend behavior doesn't suggest student activities.
